AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Constructing Water Retention Structures.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
